desc: Read N, M and the edge list.
Build adjacency list and BFS each component to 2-color vertices, recording color assignment and component size.
Count for each component: `a` = # of color 0 vertices, `b` = # of color 1 vertices, and `same` = number of existing edges whose endpoints share the same color.
Compute Grundy value `g = a*(a-1)//2 + b*(b-1)//2 - same` for the component and XOR across all components.
Verify on sample inputs and extra small cases (empty graph, single edge, star, complete bipartite).
